name: macOS Forensics
shortDescription: Integrates with macOS forensic tools like FSEParser and unifiedlog_iterator to parse system artifacts, correlate timeline events, and detect security incidents across unified logs, FSEvents, Safari history, and system databases for digital forensics investigations.
